comments.author: Kossmynn
comments.body:
Very difficult, indeed. All NPCs use sword and they poses r4 techs. Gear up properly (boots 100D+ hands 100D should do it- remember, the Q also require rise adv skills!) and bring 3 medicine types+ antidote along (the Head will use blinding powder which won't allow u to attack, so u risk to be sitting duck). Good luck!
PS: Spirit Mask should cost not only 150-200M, but 1B (for the effort)! :D

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
From my own experience, the best items to equip for this fight are:

Antidote (sold in all European capital city Item Shops)
Secret Medication (sold in Naples and East Asia city Item Shops)
Asclepius' Elixir (dropped by various NPCs and found in most EA dungeons)

With a friend's help, I managed this quest (and neither of us had any 100d equipment). It helped that we both had the Poison Dart Trap tech at our disposal; once poisoned, the NPCs' health dropped like crazy.

That said, yes, the fight is -very- difficult. At least the quest reward makes it worthwhile.
